baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired seeing verbs at words 2 and 9 lead into three alternatives: terrestrial production, a heavenly share, or a granted book yielding clear evidence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressee is first made answerable and then required to exhibit support. The alternatives form an escalating warrant ladder: produced effect, owned jurisdiction, and documentary authorization. Failure at all three leaves reciprocal promise as the only remaining support.

activation_trace.role: The alerting inquiry recruits the hearer as an answerable examiner at the start of the audit.
Causing something to be seen turns the second demand from assertion into an exhibit requirement.
Actual origination supplies the first and most material class of admissible evidence.
A jointly held portion supplies the ownership test when no created effect can be shown.
A written determination that establishes an obligation supplies the possible authorization prong.
Manifest disclosure makes any alleged charter answerable to a clarity threshold rather than mere possession.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a general denial that invoked partners are divine.
changed_reading.after: The verse is a structured burden-of-proof hearing in which causal output, proprietary share, and disclosed authorization are separately tested.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The alternatives are called from beneath or apart from God, then tested first against earth and next against the heavens.
baseline_models.mechanism: The spatial vocabulary organizes a vertical jurisdiction audit. What is near yet short of the ultimate source must show productive footing in the lower domain or a genuine stake in the upper domain; proximity, visibility, or accessibility is not title.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that remains short of the goal locates the invoked alternatives within reach but below ultimate agency.
The lower domain opposite the sky serves as the concrete production floor of the jurisdiction test.
The encompassing upper domain supplies the second, higher level in which a proprietary stake could be claimed.
Joint ownership links the named partners to the question of whether any domain is actually held in common.

changed_reading.before: Earth and heavens merely totalize creation rhetorically.
changed_reading.after: Earth and heavens stage lower and upper jurisdictional tests: the alternatives possess neither productive footing below nor an owned stake above.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The close shifts from absent evidence to wrongdoers promising one another, part to part, nothing but deception.
baseline_models.mechanism: Once external warrants fail, a fragmented group manufactures internal credit. Each part opens expectation in another part, so reciprocal assurance substitutes for independent evidence; deceptive shine and unknown outcome let the unsupported credit continue circulating.

activation_trace.role: A spoken promise opens future hope and supplies the credit unit exchanged after evidence runs out.
Mutual promising provides the feedback edge by which participants validate one another.
Partitive fragmentation makes credibility distributed among pieces rather than grounded in a whole external warrant.
A persuasive surface without stability explains how unsupported promises remain attractive in circulation.
Unknown outcome turns the promise network into risk whose liability is hidden from its participants.
Withholding what is due frames the absent evidence as a denied right, not merely an intellectual mistake.

changed_reading.before: The last clause simply calls the partners' claims lies.
changed_reading.after: The last clause diagnoses a decentralized credibility mechanism: fragments lend one another future hope until reciprocal assurance masks the absence of proof.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Seeing and showing are repeated, but the verse ends by naming a mode of deceptive appearance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sight is not treated as automatically trustworthy. The movement from attention to demanded display to manifest evidence disciplines seeing by causal and documentary checks; deceptive sheen names the rival mode in which something is visible yet evidentially empty.

activation_trace.role: Perception by eye or insight supplies the faculty being recruited and tested.
Making an object visible supplies display, which the following questions force to become verification.
Disclosure through speech, writing, or sign provides the criterion that converts display into intelligible evidence.
Visible attraction that does not hold supplies the counterexample: appearance can recruit sight while evading proof.

changed_reading.before: The commands to see are emphatic ornaments in a rhetorical question.
changed_reading.after: The verse distinguishes mere display from verified seeing and makes causal trace or disclosed warrant the safeguard against attractive appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context presents origination as opening a new order and later displays one descending material input yielding divergent visible kinds. The production challenge in 35:40 therefore tests not merely whether an alternative made an isolated object, but whether it can originate and differentiate a generative field.

activation_trace.role: Initiating existence supplies the context's opening model of authorship.
Parts taking unlike paths supplies divergence among outputs from a shared process.
Kind or type makes the repeated color variation function as produced differentiation rather than decoration alone.
Measured formation anchors the contextual differentiation back to the focus demand for created output.

structural_cues: At 35:27 one descent of water is followed by repeated, visibly different outputs in fruit and mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies initiation and a sequence from one input to diverse outputs. I infer that generative differentiation is a signature of agency. A live alternative is that the variation only illustrates power and does not narrow the semantics of the focus creation question.

changed_reading.before: The first prong asks whether the partners made any terrestrial object.
changed_reading.after: The first prong asks for a generative signature: origination capable of measuring and differentiating material outputs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opening and withholding already frame agency as ongoing control in 35:2; 35:41 then depicts the earth-heavens system as continuously held against displacement. Creation and share in 35:40 become operational tests: who presently regulates and preserves the domains, not only who began them.

activation_trace.role: Holding and restraining supplies an early control operation paired with opening and release.
Repeated restraint makes cosmic persistence an active operation rather than passive ownership.
Departure from place or state supplies the failure mode that continuous holding prevents.
The upper domain named in the focus is the same system whose stability requires present restraint.
Origination remains the focus anchor while the context extends its agency test into maintenance.

structural_cues: 35:41 repeats holding around a conditional displacement of both heavens and earth and denies any replacement holder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, withholding, and a counterfactual collapse no other agent can arrest. I infer that present maintenance is evidence of title and agency. A live alternative keeps preservation distinct from creation and reads 35:41 as reinforcement rather than a revision of the focus test.

changed_reading.before: The focus tests a past act of creation or a static share in cosmic property.
changed_reading.after: The focus also tests live operational sovereignty: regulation and continuous stabilization of the lower and upper domains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context shows decoration acting before judgment: a bad work is cosmetically improved and then seen as good. The repeated sight commands in 35:40 are therefore not confidence in unaided vision; they are a counter-deception protocol that demands production traces and disclosed warrant beyond appearance.

activation_trace.role: Applied beautification supplies the prior manipulation that conditions the later act of seeing.
Underlying badness supplies the concealed state that appearance reverses.
Actual perception registers the decorated result and demonstrates that seeing can ratify distortion.
Goodness as the opposite of badness marks the categorical reversal produced in the viewer.
The focus demand to make evidence visible becomes a corrective to the context's manipulated visibility.
Attractive instability names the focus mechanism that can exploit corrupted sight.

structural_cues: In 35:8 passive decoration precedes the subject's seeing, and seeing precedes the good judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered reversal from bad work through decoration to favorable sight. I infer that the focus's evidentiary demands are safeguards against that repeatable perceptual failure. A live alternative confines 35:8 to moral self-appraisal rather than a general epistemic warning.

changed_reading.before: The focus tells the audience to look because sight will straightforwardly disclose the truth.
changed_reading.after: The focus retrains a vulnerable faculty: only seeing disciplined by causal trace and clear warrant can resist decorated falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier ownership denial scales all the way down to a seed's thin covering. That microscopic denial sharpens the later question about a share in the heavens: an agent without title to the smallest covering cannot plausibly hold an upper-domain partnership.

activation_trace.role: Possession with power of disposal supplies the precise title denied to the invoked alternatives.
A seed's minute membrane supplies the lower bound of the ownership audit.
Joint title anchors the microscopic denial to the focus's grand claim of a heavenly share.

structural_cues: 35:13 uses the same invocation-below construction as the focus and ends with an extreme minimization of what the invoked ones own.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct ownership denial measured by a minute object. I infer an a-fortiori scale from no minimal title to no cosmic share. A live alternative treats the minute object as emphatic total negation without a formal scaling argument.

changed_reading.before: The heavenly-share question is a grand but abstract denial of co-sovereignty.
changed_reading.after: The question completes a scale test: those lacking disposable title at the smallest material level cannot own a cosmic share.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context decomposes invocation into a request-response channel: the called parties do not hear, and the counterfactual grant of hearing still produces no response. This gives the focus's invocation a functional test independent of the larger creation and title tests.

activation_trace.role: Auditory reception supplies the first missing stage in the invoked channel.
Understanding that issues in compliance distinguishes effective hearing from mere acoustic contact.
Returning an answer supplies the second missing stage even under the hearing counterfactual.
Calling by speech anchors the failed communication sequence to the focus's description of practice.

structural_cues: 35:14 moves from actual non-hearing to a concession of hypothetical hearing and then preserves non-response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two serial failures, reception and response. I infer that effective invocation requires both and that their absence is functional evidence against partnership. A live alternative reads the sequence solely as eschatological repudiation rather than a service-capability test.

changed_reading.before: Invocation in the focus is mainly a label for worship directed to the wrong object.
changed_reading.after: Invocation is also an auditable failed channel: the called parties neither receive the call effectively nor return an answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context denies both automatic burden transfer and requested load-sharing, even across kinship. Reciprocal promises in 35:40 can therefore simulate guarantees, but they cannot move liability from one participant to another when the promised outcome fails.

activation_trace.role: Guaranteeing another's load supplies the very social function that the negative construction refuses.
A heavy burden supplies the liability that remains attached to its own bearer.
Close kinship supplies the strongest ordinary social bond and still fails to enable transfer.
Exchanged assurances anchor the failed-guarantee mechanism in the focus's reciprocal promising.
Part-to-part relations identify the would-be guarantors whose promises cannot redistribute liability.

structural_cues: 35:18 first negates one bearer carrying another's burden, then negates a loaded person's call for even a portion to be carried.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-transfer under both impersonal and kinship conditions. I infer that the focus promises imply pseudo-guarantee or rescue credit. A live alternative is that the promises offer comfort or status rather than explicit liability transfer.

changed_reading.before: The reciprocal promises are false predictions about future benefit.
changed_reading.after: The promises are also counterfeit guarantees: social closeness can circulate reassurance but cannot transfer the burden attached to each participant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context later depicts a book as inherited while its bearers occupy divergent moral positions, including a middle course. This separates receiving or possessing a text from standing upon clear evidence from it; the focus's documentary prong tests authorized and evidential uptake, not an artifact alone.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of knowledge or book by inheritance supplies possession without implying uniform reception.
The written object remains common across recipients while their relation to it differs.
A middle position supplies one explicit mode within the differentiated reception of the inherited text.
Manifest clarity anchors the distinction between having a text and actually standing on evidence from it.

structural_cues: In 35:32 the single inherited book is followed by a three-way distribution of its human bearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common inheritance followed by divergent recipient positions. I infer that possession does not self-authenticate evidential standing. A live alternative reads the three positions as moral ranks among valid heirs and not as a warning about documentary proof.

changed_reading.before: Any granted book would by itself satisfy the focus's third evidentiary option.
changed_reading.after: The third option requires more than textual possession: the grant must authorize the claim and place its bearer on manifest evidence from the text.

context_deltas.mechanism: A maximally performed oath predicts greater guidance if a warner arrives, yet the arrival produces increased aversion. This keeps two readings of the focus promises live: strategic deception and sincerely felt but self-sealing assurance whose behavioral output reverses its content.

activation_trace.role: A formally apportioned oath supplies the public commitment act behind the predicted response.
The oath sense intensifies the professed certainty rather than leaving it casual.
Active recoil supplies the observed output that contradicts the oath's promised guidance.
Expectation opened by speech anchors the oath's failed forecast to the focus's promise mechanism.
Inexperience or pliant heedlessness permits self-deception to coexist with emphatic sincerity.

structural_cues: 35:42 places the strongest oath before the condition, then answers fulfillment of that condition with an increase in the opposite behavior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emphatic commitment followed by outcome inversion. I infer that some deceptive promises may be self-believed performances, not only calculated lies. A live alternative treats the oath as knowingly insincere and the aversion as exposure rather than self-deception.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers knowingly deceive one another with promises they do not believe.
changed_reading.after: The promise loop can also be self-deceiving: high-confidence speech predicts receptivity while the actual encounter produces recoil.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby bad scheme is said to descend upon and enclose its own people. This gives the focus's part-to-part deception a return path: the credibility loop does not merely send false hope outward but traps its producers inside the consequences they circulate.

activation_trace.role: Intrinsic badness marks the scheme's quality before its direction of return is specified.
Harm descending and surrounding supplies the feedback motion from scheme back to source.
The group defined by belonging supplies the bounded population enclosed by its own mechanism.
Interacting parts anchor the returning harm to the focus's distributed promise network.
Unstable attraction is the payload circulated until the network's own members are enclosed by it.

structural_cues: In 35:43 the bad scheme is repeated on both sides of the verb that assigns its enclosing effect to its own people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit return of harm to the scheme's people. I infer that the reciprocal promise network in the focus is one possible carrier of that feedback. A live alternative applies 35:43 to broader plotting without identifying the focus promises as its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Deception travels one way from a deceiver to a victim.
changed_reading.after: Part-to-part deception is a closed feedback system whose circulating promises eventually enclose the community producing them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context operationalizes inspection: move through the earth, direct sight, and compare the resulting end of stronger predecessors, whose power did not enable escape. The focus's paired seeing verbs thus open a reproducible field inquiry rather than a closed rhetorical taunt.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight supplies the deliberate observation step of the field audit.
Movement through terrain supplies access to traces beyond the immediate debate.
The final outcome supplies the longitudinal result to be inspected rather than a momentary appearance.
Incapacity to defeat the acting power supplies the negative result even for materially stronger peoples.
The focus's alerting inquiry becomes the verbal entry point to the context's travel-observe-compare procedure.

structural_cues: 35:44 orders travel before observation, observation before comparison of outcome, and comparison before the denial of escape by superior strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a travel-observe-outcome sequence and a stronger comparison group. I infer that it demonstrates how the focus's evidentiary demand can be investigated. A live alternative treats the historical command as a separate warning rather than a method for evaluating partner claims.

changed_reading.before: The focus questions are impossible demands whose only function is to silence the interlocutor.
changed_reading.after: The focus inaugurates an empirical protocol: inspect produced traces, documentary warrants, and historical outcomes rather than accepting circulating claims.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a hunting branch rather than the ordinary partnership sense. It remains anchored in the repeated partnership root, invocation, reciprocal promises, and final deception. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial-mechanical overlay, not as a replacement translation of the partnership terms.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same root names both the invoked partners and their alleged share, while calls and promises culminate in deception.

activation_trace.role: A hunter's entangling device turns the repeated partnership vocabulary into an exploratory capture topology.
A vocal pull toward something supplies the lure that draws participants into the topology.
Mutually exchanged promises supply the tightening links between captured participants.
Attractive but unstable appearance supplies the bait that makes the entanglement effective.

changed_reading.before: The partners form only a mistaken theological classification.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, partnership also images a social snare: invocation lures, mutual promises tighten, and deceptive attraction keeps the participants caught.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a non-dominant mapped root and crosses from sky to aperture. It remains anchored at the single heavens occurrence and sharpens the question of how foreign agency could enter the upper order. Downstream prose must label it a form-distant activation and avoid claiming that the heavens lexically mean a hole or poison.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The alleged share is specifically located in the heavens at word 18.

activation_trace.role: A narrow opening through which something enters supplies an exploratory model of an access point into the upper order.
Joint participation turns the imagined access point into a question about where another agency could enter shared operation.

changed_reading.before: A heavenly share means an abstract percentage of upper-domain ownership.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the question also asks for an entry point: where does the partners' agency penetrate or connect to the upper order at all?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the promise root's split mapping into counting and comparison. It remains anchored in the focus's promise, repeated part-to-part relation, and partnership vocabulary. Downstream prose should frame it as an accounting analogy for social credibility, not as the lexical meaning of the promise verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: One part promises another after every external warrant has failed.

activation_trace.role: A counterpart counted alongside another supplies the ledger operation by which peers are treated as collateral.
Discrete parts supply the separate accounts that credit one another without an external asset.
Shared interest supplies the common pool against which the peer promises appear to be booked.
Uncertainty of outcome exposes the resulting peer-backed ledger as unsupported risk.

changed_reading.before: The promises are unstructured verbal encouragement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they form a peer-credit ledger in which each fragment counts another as collateral although no productive, proprietary, or documentary asset exists.

strongest_changes: The focus became a three-pronged burden-of-proof hearing rather than a single generic denial.
Context revised creation from a past event into differentiated production plus continuous maintenance.
The seeing commands became a counter-deception discipline because prior decoration can make bad work appear good.
Reciprocal promises became a closed credit and pseudo-guarantee system whose liabilities cannot transfer and whose effects return to its own group.
The challenge became investigable through communication failure, microscopic ownership, textual uptake, and historical field observation.
summary.what_was_special: The verse repeatedly converts relation into audit: named partners must show output, title, or warrant, while the final part-to-part promises reveal what replaces evidence inside a self-supporting network. The most productive surprise was that seeing itself is both the requested method and a vulnerable faculty requiring causal and documentary controls.
remaining_uncertainties: The book prong may emphasize revealed authorization, binding decree, documentary proof, or more than one of these at once.
The partitive phrase about earth may test created material, a created portion, terrestrial output, or overlapping possibilities.
Reciprocal promises may be deliberate manipulation, sincerely held self-deception, or a mixture across participants.
The snare, access-point, and ledger readings are branch-licensed activations but remain too form-distant to state as direct lexical renderings.
